create_GPTBigCodeConfig: create a GPTBigCodeConfig instance with default model settings for BigCode initialization
build_GPTBigCodeModel: build a GPTBigCodeModel with random weights using a GPTBigCodeConfig instance
configure_multi_query_attention: configure GPTBigCodeConfig to enable or disable multi-query attention mode
customize_attention_precision: customize GPTBigCodeConfig to set attention_softmax_in_fp32 and scale_attention_softmax_in_fp32 settings
access_model_config: access the model configuration via model.config after instantiating a GPTBigCodeModel
